alert.title: The Alert

shots.say: Would you survive the night?
At midnight, every phone in the city buzzed at once.
Stay inside. Lock your door. And do not make a sound.
Outside, something is walking. Very. Slowly.
You turn off every light.
Then your stomach growls. Really loud.
Every zombie on the street stops, and looks up at your window.
Do you hide under the bed, or run for the roof?

stairs.title: The Stairs

shots.say: If you picked B, this one is for you.
Knock. Knock. Knock.
You sneak out the back. The hallway light is flickering.
Twelve floors. No elevator. Run!
On floor ten, you hear footsteps, right below you.
The roof door. Is. Locked.
Do you break the door, or climb the pipe?

roof.title: The Roof

shots.say: If you picked B, you climbed the pipe.
You pull yourself onto the roof. The whole city is dark.
Then a light sweeps across the sky. A helicopter!
But the zombies hear it too.
The roof door starts to shake.
Do you wave for the helicopter, or hide behind the water tank?

twist.title: The Twist

shots.say: Everyone who waved: the helicopter saw you.
A rope drops down. You grab it and hold on tight.
Below you, the zombies all stop, and start to dance?
Wait. Was it all a giant zombie dance party?
Your phone buzzes one last time.
Should we make season two? Comment yes or no!

season2.title: Season 2

shots.say: You voted yes. So the zombies are back, and they're dancing.
The helicopter drops you on a new roof, far from the city.
The pilot yells one thing before flying away.
They only dance while the music plays!
As long as they dance, they can't chase you.
You find a room with a speaker playing music.
Your phone is the only thing connected to it.
Then you see it. Five percent battery.
Four percent. Your hands start shaking.
You run into the hallway, looking for a charger.
At the end of the hallway, something is standing still.
One percent. The music begins to fade.
Every zombie stops dancing, and turns around.
Do you find a charger, or find a radio?

radio.title: The Radio

shots.say: The music is gone. And something is banging on the door.
If you picked A, the charger was broken. Game over.
If you picked B, you ran for the radio room. Good choice.
The thing at the end of the hallway is getting closer.
A sign says: radio room. You slam the door behind you.
There it is. An old radio, covered in dust.
You turn the dial. Static.
More static. Nothing works.
Knock. Knock. Knock.
You remember rule number two.
You turn the dial one last time.
And music starts playing! Very, very quietly.
But outside, the zombies are still not dancing.
Do you sing really loud, or bang on pots and pans?

radio.caption: Static... knocking... and only one way to make them dance again 📻🧟 STICKMAN SURVIVAL — Season 2, Part 6. song.title: The Song

shots.say: You sing so loud, the whole city can hear you.
If you picked B, the pots were too loud. They found you.
But if you picked A, they started dancing again!
Now there's a new rule.
Then your phone rings. Unknown number.
It's the pilot. Get to the roof, we're coming back!
Twenty-one floors. You run and sing at the same time.
Your voice is getting tired.
On floor eighteen, you hear footsteps right below you.
You stop singing to catch your breath.
Big mistake. Every zombie stops dancing.
And now they're all running up the stairs.
Two floors left. The roof door is right there.
Do you keep running, or start humming really quietly?

song.caption: Never stop singing... until you do 🎤🧟 STICKMAN SURVIVAL — Season 2, Part 7. Every frame drawn by hand in Framey, the stop-motion app. Want to make videos like this? finale2.title: The Rescue

shots.say: The roof door is locked. Again.
If you picked B, humming was too quiet. They caught you.
But if you picked A, you kept running. Good.
You pull. You push. It will not open.
Then someone knocks. From the roof side.
A voice whispers: step back.
The door flies open. It's the pilot!
She throws down a rope. Grab it!
You hold on as tight as you can.
Below you, the zombies are dancing again.
One of them waves goodbye. Wait, is that your neighbor?
Then your phone buzzes one last time.
The message just says: Season three?
Should we make season three? Comment yes or no!

finale2.caption: You made it out... but wait, was that your NEIGHBOR? 🚁🧟 STICKMAN SURVIVAL — Season 2 finale, Part 8. s3text.title: The Text

shots.say: You voted yes. So here we go. Season three.
You climb into the helicopter. You're safe. For now.
Then your phone buzzes. A text, from your neighbor.
It says: I'm not a zombie. Come back and get me.
Down below, he's still dancing with them. Is he telling the truth?
The pilot shakes her head. We only have fuel for one trip.
Then every zombie stops dancing, and looks up at the helicopter.
Do you go back for your neighbor, or fly away?

s3door.title: Going Back

shots.say: If you picked B, you flew away, and never found out the truth.
But if you picked A, the helicopter turns around.
It lands on your old roof. The engine is way too loud.
The roof door is locked. Of course it is.
Then, knock. Knock. From the inside.
A voice says: It's me. Open the door. Hurry.
Do you open the door, or ask him something only your real neighbor would know?

s3question.title: The Question

shots.say: If you picked A, you opened the door. It was not your neighbor.
But if you picked B, you ask: what's the name of my dog?
Silence. Then: Biscuit. It's really him!
You open the door. Behind him, the hallway is full of zombies.
Run! Up the stairs! Two floors to go!
You both grab the rope. The helicopter starts to lift.
Then you hear barking. Biscuit is still inside!
Do you wait for Biscuit, or take off right now?

s3finale.title: Biscuit

shots.say: If you picked B, you took off. Your neighbor never talked to you again.
But if you picked A, you wait. One second. Two seconds.
Biscuit runs out of the dark, with something in his mouth.
It's the radio. And it's still playing music.
Every zombie in the building starts dancing again.
Biscuit jumps. You catch him. Up, up, and away!
Then your phone buzzes one last time.
Should we make season four? Comment yes or no!
